notes.title: Demo Now Available for Download!
notes.content:
Mouse Practice for Kids is a fun and educational game designed to help children learn essential mouse skills. Kids can practice moving the cursor and clicking on colorful fruits while improving their fine motor skills in a joyful, engaging environment.

[b]What’s in the Demo?[/b]

[list]
[*] Easy Difficulty: Perfect for younger players to get started.
[*] First 25 Levels: Experience the beginning of the game and see how it progressively teaches kids through increasing challenges.
[*] A progressive difficulty system where fruits and the cursor get smaller and even move!
[*] Cheerful music and sound effects to keep kids entertained.
[*] Parental Control Timer: Set a playtime limit (e.g., 10, 15, or 20 minutes) to ensure a balanced and safe screen time experience.
[/list]

Download the demo on our Steam page and let your little ones give it a try! Your feedback will help us improve the game as we continue development.

Don’t forget to wishlist the full game to support its development and stay updated on its release!
Thank you for your support! We look forward to hearing your thoughts!
